authorization: Owner subsequently authorized pinned official local host weights/runtime download and real host inference; no Fold7 or release authorization inferred.
mandatoryPreconditions: Chief supplies immutable integrated source SHA containing independently accepted genuine inference producer and canonical claimed workspace caller.
Official model and runtime provenance are verified independently; model kind or process brand alone cannot establish inference.
Frozen manifest verifies; existing materialized source/test hashes match; actual baseline fails an assertion.
Each task uses canonical prepareCodingTask grant and runCodingTask with requireIsolation and requireLocalModelObservation, expected task fingerprint, and existing owner-configured executor.
No providerFactory, fake run, scripted patch, teacher answer or solution is supplied by QA.
recordPerTask: RED and GREEN raw execution evidence
successRule: A task is solved only after genuine admitted local inference proposes its source patch and unchanged real acceptance tests pass independent verification. Review-ready patch does not grant merge/install/release authority.

memoryPair.policy: Current recall requires exact sourceCommit. These frozen tasks have different source SHAs; never weaken policy to make a positive ablation.
memoryPair.execution: Use shared synthetic state only if canonical checkout/grant boundaries allow it. Record exact recall outcome and bindings. If cross-source recall is denied, report BLOCKED_CROSS_SOURCE_POLICY; do not invent a learning gain or run a redundant claimed-memory arm.
memoryPair.restart: Same-source persisted recall may be checked through the existing read-only recall helper with canonical grants; no resubmission or owner approval inferred.
